# FastAIAgent SDK

> Python SDK to build, debug, evaluate and operate AI agents. Apache-2.0. Runs standalone; connects to a FastAIAgent platform optionally.

Assistants: read the full reference first. It lists the mistakes assistants make with this SDK, then covers each area.

## Read first

- [Full reference for coding assistants](https://docs.fastaiagent.net/llms-full.txt): the ten rules, then agents, tools, teams, guardrails, evals, platform, testing, what changed
- [Use fastaiagent with a coding assistant](https://docs.fastaiagent.net/getting-started/coding-assistants/): install the skills (`fastaiagent skills install`)
- [Agent Studio from the command line](https://docs.fastaiagent.net/platform/agent-studio/): build an agent through Agent Studio with `fastaiagent studio` (the spec, the commands, the errors); also the last part of the full reference above

## Documentation

- [Getting started](https://docs.fastaiagent.net/getting-started/): Install, first agent, coding-assistant skills
- [Agents](https://docs.fastaiagent.net/agents/): Agent, LLMClient, AgentConfig, middleware, memory, teams, swarm
- [Tools](https://docs.fastaiagent.net/tools/): @tool, REST tools, MCP tools, replay_class
- [Chains](https://docs.fastaiagent.net/chains/): Graph workflows: cycles, typed nodes, human approval
- [Guardrails](https://docs.fastaiagent.net/guardrails/): Input, output and tool-call safety checks
- [Evaluation](https://docs.fastaiagent.net/evaluation/): evaluate(), scorers, the pytest plugin, CI gates
- [Testing without a model](https://docs.fastaiagent.net/testing/): TestModel and FunctionModel
- [Tracing and replay](https://docs.fastaiagent.net/tracing/): Local traces, OpenTelemetry, replay
- [Platform](https://docs.fastaiagent.net/platform/): connect(), prompts, push, the runner
- [CLI](https://docs.fastaiagent.net/cli/): Every fastaiagent command

## Source

- [fastaiagent-sdk](https://github.com/fastaifoundry/fastaiagent-sdk)
- [Agent Skills for coding assistants](https://github.com/fastaifoundry/fastaiagent-skills)
